newsitem.title: USA: General Mills honors amateurs on Team Cheerios.
newsitem.headline: General Mills honors amateurs on Team Cheerios.

text.p: General Mills Inc., whose Wheaties cereal boxes sport photos of famous professional athletes, Wednesday announced a new cereal dubbed Team Cheerios that will celebrate amateur athletes.

Four teams have been tapped to be featured on boxes of Team Cheerios, a combination of three different "O" shapes made with whole-grain oats and whole-grain corn sweetened with brown sugar and frosting.

The first boxes will feature the Oregon City High School girls' basketball team; Westminster Christian High School boys' baseball team from Miami; Northampton (Pa.) High School girls' softball team and Lewisville (Texas) High School football, said General Mills, which is based in Minneapolis.
"These four teams are each featured on packages that will be in grocery stores across the country," Chris Helle, marketing manager for the new cereal, said in a statement issued in Oregon City.
He said General Mills was looking for other teams to honour.
The company said any school or sandlot team may be nominated. A special advisory board has been set up to judge the nominations.
